entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西语词头在 ó 之后截断（[殘]），义不能定。

entries.zh: 使身体降下、俯下；抬运尸体下来（下葬）
entries.en: to lower the body (bend down); to carry down the body/corpse for burial
entries.notes: 词尾 beᵐ 为手稿缩写（疑作 bien/va 之互见语），展开依赖推断；闽南语音写 pag-sūn 未能确证对应。

entries.zh: 取下或放低坠落之物（如灯）
entries.en: to take down something that has fallen, e.g., a lamp
entries.notes: 闽南语音写 uy-lō-piānn 未能确证，按西语词头释义。

entries.en: to lower while weaving, letting down the threads
entries.notes: texando 为 texer（织）之现在分词，织布时放低纱线属推断；音写 tuy-lō-tay 未能确证。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: cauandera 与 bariedola 均无法确认为 17 世纪西语词形，疑为讹写，语义无法定夺。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: congruato 非通行西语词形，疑为讹写或缩写，闽南语音写 cau-lō-tay 亦未能对应，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 天上降下水；如洪水之灾
entries.en: to send down water from heaven, as in a deluge/flood
to send down fire from heaven; heavenly fire

entries.zh: 从天上降下，如石头、冰雹
entries.en: to come down from the sky, as stone or hail
entries.notes: 音写 ttzō-cháy-hāy 疑含石、災害成分但对应不全，按西语词头释义。

entries.en: to come down tumbling, turning as it falls
entries.notes: 音写 pag-tūn-tūy 疑含跌落、转落成分而未能确证，按西语词头释义。

entries.en: to take something down by turning it
entries.notes: 音写 chiū-lō 未能确证，按西语词头释义。

entries.zh: 从天降下；如天主降生成人（道成肉身）
entries.en: to descend from heaven, as God made flesh (the Incarnation)
entries.notes: 音写 cāng-in 疑为降字组词（降生成人之义），对应依赖推断。

entries.en: to come down; to descend into the world
entries.notes: 音写 cāng-sī 疑为降世一类降字词，对应依赖推断。

entries.en: to come down, to descend
entries.notes: 音写 cāng-hē 疑为降下，对应依赖推断。

entries.en: to come down; to descend to the mortal world
entries.notes: 音写 cāng-hōan 疑为降凡，对应依赖推断。

entries.en: to come down in this manner
entries.notes: 音写 cāng-tay 后字未能确证，按西语词头并参同页降字组词推断。

entries.en: to descend, as of the Holy Spirit
entries.notes: 音写 cāng-tūn 后字未能确证，按西语词头释义。

entries.en: to bring down phlegm; to lower the humors
〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西语 bumon 非通行词形（疑讹写或缩写），音写 cāng-quī 疑为降旗但无法与西语互证，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 降职；贬黜（使身份地位下降）
entries.en: to demote; to lower in dignity or rank
to bring down the fire; to quench or appease it
to come down of a bird; to alight
to come down as the ant crawls down the wall
entries.notes: 音写 chiū-chī-tay 未能确证，按西语词头释义。

entries.zh: 倾倒便器；清运粪水（水肥）
entries.en: to empty or take down the chamber pot; night-soil removal
entries.notes: 西语 Camarea 疑为 cámara（便器）之讹写，音写 chūy-pūy-cū 疑为水肥（车），对应依赖推断。
